action-mask-rule:maskType.meaning: Chooses what a modifier or mask region is intended to affect. A mask is an auxiliary region, not automatically a printable part.
action-mask-rule:maskType.when_to_change: When deliberately restricting support or applying a documented regional modifier, not during a basic material comparison.
action-mask-rule:maskType.effect: Changing the class can change which toolpaths are permitted in the region. It does not simply change the colour of the region.
action-mask-rule:maskType.caution: Internal-mask versus full-mask coverage is not established by these labels; inspect the resulting preview. The option names below are source labels, not a live visibility guarantee.

options.label: Support blocker
options.meaning: A region intended to prevent support generation where it intersects. It does not make an unsupported overhang printable without support.

options.label: Support enforcer
options.meaning: A region intended to request support. Other support eligibility and geometry rules may still matter; verify the preview rather than assuming support appears everywhere.

options.label: Internal mask
options.meaning: Selects the internal-mask class. The precise roles and boundary treatment affected are unresolved in this survey; do not assume it cuts a cavity or changes a tool.

options.label: Full mask
options.meaning: Selects the full-mask class. Its exact difference from internal mask is not verified; do not assume it removes the model or applies every setting throughout it.

action-mask-rule:maskType.status: Schema-backed selector; partly interpreted; mask-class details unverified.

action-mask-rule:name.meaning: Identifies this mask rule so a person can distinguish its purpose from other modifiers.
action-mask-rule:name.when_to_change: When naming or revising a rule, using a description such as the region and intended support action.
action-mask-rule:name.effect: A clearer name improves traceability; the name alone is not evidence that the mask has the intended geometry or settings.
action-mask-rule:name.caution: The editor control type was not resolved. Do not infer an automatic operation from a descriptive name.

composite-settings:bedTemperature.meaning: The requested build-plate temperature for normal composite printing, in degrees Celsius.
composite-settings:bedTemperature.when_to_change: During a controlled adhesion or thermal-management comparison for the approved matrix/fibre pair and actual plate.
composite-settings:bedTemperature.effect: Higher can improve adhesion but increase bottom deformation and heat exposure; lower may reduce those effects but allow lifting.
composite-settings:bedTemperature.caution: A temperature field is not a plate or material rating. Do not use bed heat to compensate for a loose plate or leaking hotend.

composite-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.meaning: The build-plate temperature requested during the initial-layer stage of the composite material.
composite-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.when_to_change: Only after first-layer geometry and plate preparation are correct, when comparing initial adhesion.
composite-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.effect: More initial heat may help attachment but can enlarge or soften bottom features. Less may reduce flare but weaken attachment.
composite-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.caution: The exact transition trigger must be checked in output; do not assume this follows the fan-height or nozzle-temperature-height field identically.
composite-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.status: Label-based thermal interpretation; transition details unverified.

composite-settings:chamberTemperature.meaning: The requested chamber temperature for the composite material, where the machine supports active chamber heating.
composite-settings:chamberTemperature.when_to_change: When qualifying the approved material pair's enclosure conditions, within current machine and material guidance.
composite-settings:chamberTemperature.effect: A warmer environment can reduce thermal contraction but may worsen small details, feed-path heat exposure or cooling balance.
composite-settings:chamberTemperature.caution: Entering a target does not prove a chamber heater exists, its sensor is correct or the target was reached. Never change hardware capability flags to force heating.
composite-settings:chamberTemperature.status: Functional interpretation; hardware operation not tested.

composite-settings:color.meaning: The colour assigned to the composite material's on-screen representation.
composite-settings:color.when_to_change: To make the selected material identifiable and keep the visual record consistent with the intended spool.
composite-settings:color.effect: Changes the representation; it does not dye the part, load a fibre or prove which physical spool is installed.
composite-settings:color.caution: Colour additives can affect real tuning, but changing this swatch does not retune temperature or flow.

composite-settings:costPerSpool.meaning: Purchase cost for one continuous-fibre spool, in the application's selected currency.
composite-settings:costPerSpool.when_to_change: When recording a different price or spool product for cost reporting.
composite-settings:costPerSpool.effect: Can change estimated material cost. A higher entered price is not stronger or faster fibre.
composite-settings:costPerSpool.caution: The currency placeholder in the source label is dynamic. Cost metadata is not proof of loaded material or route eligibility.
composite-settings:costPerSpool.status: Accounting interpretation; exact costing formula unverified.

composite-settings:description.meaning: Free-form notes about this composite-material definition.
composite-settings:description.when_to_change: To record pair compatibility, conditioning, test status, limitations and evidence references.
composite-settings:description.effect: Improves the human record; notes do not enforce the settings they describe.
composite-settings:description.caution: Do not place credentials, private identifiers or unsupported TUNED claims in exported notes.
composite-settings:description.status: Schema-backed notes field; not an enforcement mechanism.

composite-settings:enablePreheat.meaning: Enables the composite material's separate nozzle-preheat behaviour.
composite-settings:enablePreheat.when_to_change: Only when the supported OEM preparation sequence calls for a separate preheat stage.
composite-settings:enablePreheat.effect: Enabling may request the configured preheat temperature before printing; disabling does not itself prove the nozzle stays cold.
composite-settings:enablePreheat.caution: Do not disable preparation requirements to bypass a loading problem. Actual timing and waits must be checked in the supported workflow.
composite-settings:enablePreheat.status: Label-based switch interpretation; lifecycle timing unverified.

composite-settings:enablePrintCooling.meaning: Allows the composite material's print-cooling schedule to control its assigned part-cooling fan.
composite-settings:enablePrintCooling.when_to_change: During a documented cooling comparison, not to silence an unidentified fan.
composite-settings:enablePrintCooling.effect: Enabling allows the configured initial and regular cooling requests; disabling does not prove every machine fan stops.
composite-settings:enablePrintCooling.caution: This is not authority to stop a protective hotend heatsink fan. Confirm the physical fan role before changing it.
composite-settings:enablePrintCooling.status: Functional interpretation; fan routing requires hardware verification.

composite-settings:extraLengthP.meaning: Additional matrix-plastic feed associated with unretraction, beyond restoring the ordinary retracted amount.
composite-settings:extraLengthP.when_to_change: Only after supported composite retraction is understood and repeated restarts show a genuine matrix shortage.
composite-settings:extraLengthP.effect: More can fill a lean restart but create a blob or excess pressure; less can reduce buildup but leave a gap.
composite-settings:extraLengthP.caution: This is matrix plastic, not continuous-fibre length or a repair for leakage. Exact restart application must be checked in output.
composite-settings:extraLengthP.status: Label-based material interpretation; restart algorithm unverified.

composite-settings:extraLengthPOnToolCha.meaning: Additional matrix-plastic feed associated specifically with recovery after a tool change.
composite-settings:extraLengthPOnToolCha.when_to_change: When a verified tool-change test, rather than ordinary travel, shows a repeatable matrix restart deficit.
composite-settings:extraLengthPOnToolCha.effect: Increasing can improve an underfed return but add a blob; decreasing can reduce over-priming while risking starvation.
interactions: Standby temperature and before/after tool-change code
composite-settings:extraLengthPOnToolCha.caution: Do not copy an ordinary plastic value here or use this to alter the continuous-fibre loading cycle.
composite-settings:extraLengthPOnToolCha.status: Functional interpretation; complete tool lifecycle unvalidated.

composite-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.meaning: Scales the matrix-plastic amount commanded for the composite material; it is separate from continuous-fibre feed.
composite-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.when_to_change: For a supported, controlled matrix-flow comparison with the approved pair and loading state held fixed.
composite-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.effect: Higher requests more matrix and may improve coverage or cause buildup; lower requests less and can leave a poorly wetted or underfilled route.
interactions: Fibre route geometry, temperature and speed
composite-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.caution: A multiplier is not a safe pressure limit or proof that empty-fibre operation is supported. Do not infer a fibre percentage from it.
composite-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.status: Functional interpretation; actual composite deposition unvalidated.

composite-settings:extrusionSpeedF.meaning: Fibre-feed speed in the composite material's restart settings, measured as strand length per second.
composite-settings:extrusionSpeedF.when_to_change: Only under a supported composite restart procedure after the physical path and loading state are proven.
composite-settings:extrusionSpeedF.effect: A faster feed changes the restart's delivery rate; it is not necessarily the speed of every reinforced model route.
interactions: Restart lift, pause and matrix delivery
composite-settings:extrusionSpeedF.caution: Do not treat this as ordinary plastic print speed. Excessive strand feeding can buckle, tangle or misplace fibre; exact scheduling is unverified.

composite-settings:extrusionSpeedP.meaning: The speed used to restore retracted matrix plastic, not the toolhead's model-printing speed.
composite-settings:extrusionSpeedP.when_to_change: After distance is stable, if supported matrix restart tests show a speed-related gap or surge.
composite-settings:extrusionSpeedP.effect: Faster restoration can recover pressure sooner but demand more from the feed system; slower may reduce the surge but delay recovery.
interactions: Matrix retract length and extra unretract
composite-settings:extrusionSpeedP.caution: Do not copy ordinary FFF unretract settings to this path without an approved composite comparison.
composite-settings:extrusionSpeedP.status: Label-based retraction interpretation; physical response unvalidated.

composite-settings:fiberDiameter.meaning: The stated diameter of the continuous-fibre strand, not the composite nozzle diameter.
composite-settings:fiberDiameter.when_to_change: When accurately defining a different supported fibre product using its specification or reliable measurement.
composite-settings:fiberDiameter.effect: May affect material calculations or compatibility assumptions. It does not physically resize the guide or nozzle.
composite-settings:fiberDiameter.caution: Do not falsify the diameter to change feed or force an unsupported strand through the system; exact downstream use is unverified.

composite-settings:fiberManufacturer.meaning: Identifies who supplies the continuous fibre in this pair.
composite-settings:fiberManufacturer.when_to_change: When creating the record for the actual fibre product or correcting inaccurate identification.
composite-settings:fiberManufacturer.effect: Distinguishes supply sources; changing the text alone does not change the actual strand or qualify compatibility.
composite-settings:fiberManufacturer.caution: Control type is unresolved. A matching manufacturer name is not proof of equivalent sizing, treatment or performance.

composite-settings:fiberName.meaning: The product name identifying the continuous-fibre component.
composite-settings:fiberName.when_to_change: To match the real spool and retain a distinct record when the product changes.
composite-settings:fiberName.effect: Improves identification but does not load fibre, change the cut cycle or transfer another product's tune.
composite-settings:fiberName.caution: The form type is unresolved. Do not assume renaming creates a newly compatible material.

composite-settings:fiberSpoolLength.meaning: The total continuous-fibre length per spool, with the schema expressing this quantity in kilometres.
composite-settings:fiberSpoolLength.when_to_change: For a different supported spool size or accurate inventory and cost estimates.
composite-settings:fiberSpoolLength.effect: Can change reported available quantity or cost per length. It is not the commanded amount for one route.
composite-settings:fiberSpoolLength.caution: Do not enter metres as kilometres. A remaining-length estimate is not a physical loading or runout check.
composite-settings:fiberSpoolLength.status: Inventory interpretation; exact accounting behaviour unverified.

composite-settings:fiberType.meaning: Describes the kind of continuous reinforcement used in the pair.
composite-settings:fiberType.when_to_change: Only to identify the actual approved fibre family/product, not to obtain another route by relabelling it.
composite-settings:fiberType.effect: May participate in material categorisation; the exact dispatch or compatibility effect is not established by the label.
interactions: Fibre product, diameter and matrix pairing
composite-settings:fiberType.caution: Control type and available choices are unresolved. Do not substitute chopped-fibre plastic for a continuous-fibre type.
composite-settings:fiberType.status: Metadata/function boundary unresolved; no compatibility qualification.

composite-settings:finishIroningDistance.meaning: A distance in the composite restart/finish settings associated with ironing or pressing a route end.
composite-settings:finishIroningDistance.when_to_change: Only during an OEM-supported composite end/restart investigation with the route and loading state fixed.
composite-settings:finishIroningDistance.effect: A longer distance can extend end treatment; a shorter one can leave less treatment. Exact path, timing and feed behaviour are not established here.
interactions: Restart lift, pause and material temperature
composite-settings:finishIroningDistance.caution: This is not ordinary top-surface ironing. Do not use it to hide a failed cut or mechanically loose hotend.
composite-settings:finishIroningDistance.status: Label/context interpretation; exact finishing algorithm unresolved.

composite-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.meaning: The height in millimetres over which the composite initial-layer fan setting is intended to apply.
composite-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.when_to_change: When isolating early-layer cooling after adhesion and the supported composite baseline are reliable.
composite-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.effect: A greater height keeps the initial cooling condition over more of the part; it does not mean that many numbered layers.
interactions: Layer height and regular fan speed
composite-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.caution: Check the transition in output; rounding to layers and boundary inclusion are not verified. Do not confuse this with initial nozzle-temperature height.

composite-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.meaning: The requested part-cooling percentage during the composite initial cooling stage.
composite-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.when_to_change: For an early-layer adhesion/curl comparison while preserving the correct fan mapping.
composite-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.effect: More cooling can sharpen edges but weaken attachment or bonding; less retains heat but may permit curling or soft features.
composite-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.caution: A percentage is not measured airflow. This must not be confused with a hotend-protection fan.
composite-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.status: Functional interpretation; airflow and physical result unvalidated.

composite-settings:firstLayersHeight.meaning: The height in millimetres associated with using the composite initial-layer nozzle temperature.
composite-settings:firstLayersHeight.when_to_change: When comparing how long the initial thermal condition should persist after a reliable first layer.
composite-settings:firstLayersHeight.effect: Increasing extends that condition in height; decreasing switches toward normal printing temperature sooner.
composite-settings:firstLayersHeight.caution: This is a height, not a layer count. Verify the actual temperature transition and do not infer a separate bed/fan transition from it.
composite-settings:firstLayersHeight.status: Label-based thermal-stage interpretation; boundary details unverified.

composite-settings:linearDensity.meaning: Fibre mass per length, expressed in tex: grams per 1,000 metres of strand.
composite-settings:linearDensity.when_to_change: When defining a supported fibre product from its actual specification.
composite-settings:linearDensity.effect: Changes the relationship between fibre length and estimated mass; it is not ordinary plastic density or a feed-speed percentage.
composite-settings:linearDensity.caution: Do not enter grams per metre or plastic density in this field. Its exact use outside accounting remains unverified.
composite-settings:linearDensity.status: Unit-defined material interpretation; downstream use unverified.

composite-settings:name.meaning: The human-readable identity of the combined composite-material definition.
composite-settings:name.when_to_change: When creating a separately scoped candidate or recording a revision for the real matrix/fibre pair.
composite-settings:name.effect: Helps select the intended pair; the label alone does not change physical loading or enforce tool compatibility.
interactions: Saved profile associations and revision record
composite-settings:name.caution: Control type and accepted name characters are unresolved here. Do not mark an unvalidated pair TUNED.

composite-settings:plasticCostPerSpool.meaning: The purchase cost of the matrix-plastic spool, separate from the continuous-fibre spool.
composite-settings:plasticCostPerSpool.when_to_change: When the matrix price or supplied spool changes.
composite-settings:plasticCostPerSpool.effect: May change job-cost estimates without changing the amount of material printed.
composite-settings:plasticCostPerSpool.caution: The currency is a dynamic application choice. Do not treat total composite cost as a strength or coverage measure.
composite-settings:plasticCostPerSpool.status: Accounting interpretation; exact cost formula unverified.

composite-settings:plasticDensity.meaning: The density recorded for the matrix plastic, distinct from fibre linear density.
composite-settings:plasticDensity.when_to_change: For an accurately identified supported matrix product using its specification and the displayed units.
composite-settings:plasticDensity.effect: Can affect mass/consumption calculations. A denser value does not by itself mean more commanded matrix flow.
composite-settings:plasticDensity.caution: This form's unit was not resolved; verify it before entering a number. Do not adjust density as an extrusion-multiplier shortcut.
composite-settings:plasticDensity.status: Material/accounting interpretation; unit and exact downstream effect unresolved.

composite-settings:plasticDiameter.meaning: The diameter of the incoming matrix-plastic filament, not the output nozzle or reinforcement strand.
composite-settings:plasticDiameter.when_to_change: When defining the actual supported filament or correcting a proven diameter-entry error.
composite-settings:plasticDiameter.effect: Diameter can affect conversion between requested plastic volume and feed length. A larger entered diameter generally implies less length for the same volume; confirm actual implementation.
interactions: Physical feed path and material identity
composite-settings:plasticDiameter.caution: Do not alter this to compensate for a clog or tune flow by falsifying material dimensions.
composite-settings:plasticDiameter.status: Functional material interpretation; exact feed conversion unverified.

composite-settings:plasticManufacturer.meaning: Identifies the manufacturer of the matrix plastic used with the continuous fibre.
composite-settings:plasticManufacturer.when_to_change: When documenting the actual product source or creating a distinct material candidate.
composite-settings:plasticManufacturer.effect: Improves traceability; it does not establish equivalent behaviour between brands.
interactions: Approved fibre pairing and lot record
composite-settings:plasticManufacturer.caution: Control type is unresolved. A matching base polymer is not proof of an approved matrix/fibre combination.

composite-settings:plasticName.meaning: The product name of the matrix-plastic component, separate from the pair name and fibre name.
composite-settings:plasticName.when_to_change: To match the loaded matrix spool and distinguish formulation or colour variants.
composite-settings:plasticName.effect: Changes identification; a name change alone does not retune temperature or feed.
composite-settings:plasticName.caution: The form type is unresolved. Check the real spool instead of trusting a familiar label.

composite-settings:plasticSpoolWeight.meaning: The matrix-plastic spool quantity recorded in grams for material accounting.
composite-settings:plasticSpoolWeight.when_to_change: When documenting a different supplied spool amount using Rocket's intended net/gross convention.
composite-settings:plasticSpoolWeight.effect: Can change cost or capacity estimates; it does not set the amount extruded on one route.
composite-settings:plasticSpoolWeight.caution: Whether the application expects net filament mass or another spool convention is not established. Verify rather than including packaging weight by guess.

composite-settings:plasticType.meaning: Classifies the matrix plastic by material family.
composite-settings:plasticType.when_to_change: Only to accurately identify the supported loaded product, not to unlock another preset by relabelling it.
composite-settings:plasticType.effect: May influence categorisation or matching, but it does not prove the product's temperature, adhesion or fibre compatibility.
composite-settings:plasticType.caution: Control type/choices and any automatic preset dispatch are unresolved. PCTG, PETG and nylon are not interchangeable because some properties are similar.
composite-settings:plasticType.status: Metadata/dispatch interpretation; exact selection behaviour unresolved.

composite-settings:primingLineHeight.meaning: The height associated with the composite priming line used during preparation.
composite-settings:primingLineHeight.when_to_change: Only in a supported preparation calibration, after the physical tool/plate relationship is known.
composite-settings:primingLineHeight.effect: A changed height alters how the preparation line is deposited or contacts the surface. The exact relationship to nozzle Z is not established here.
composite-settings:primingLineHeight.caution: This is not a global first-layer correction. An incorrect preparation height can scrape or produce an unattached prime.
composite-settings:primingLineHeight.status: Preparation-height interpretation; exact motion semantics unverified.

composite-settings:regularFanSpeed.meaning: The ordinary part-cooling percentage requested after the composite initial cooling stage.
composite-settings:regularFanSpeed.when_to_change: For a controlled comparison of route shape and matrix/fibre bonding under representative chamber conditions.
composite-settings:regularFanSpeed.effect: More cooling can improve shape but weaken bonding; less can improve heat retention while increasing softness or curl.
interactions: Assigned fan, temperature and route speed
composite-settings:regularFanSpeed.caution: Other feature or machine commands may override this request. It is not a measured airflow or hotend-heatsink setting.
composite-settings:regularFanSpeed.status: Functional interpretation; effective fan lifecycle unvalidated.

composite-settings:retractionLengthOnToo.meaning: The matrix-plastic withdrawal distance associated with changing away from its tool.
composite-settings:retractionLengthOnToo.when_to_change: Only when an approved tool-change comparison isolates ooze or restart problems in this matrix path.
composite-settings:retractionLengthOnToo.effect: More withdrawal may reduce ooze but delay recovery or disturb feeding; less may leave pressure and dripping.
composite-settings:retractionLengthOnToo.caution: This is not ordinary travel retraction, fibre withdrawal or a full unload. Do not substitute another tool's values.

composite-settings:retractionLengthOnTra.meaning: The matrix-plastic withdrawal distance associated with eligible non-printing travel.
composite-settings:retractionLengthOnTra.when_to_change: Only through a supported composite test after moisture, temperature and physical feeding are stable.
composite-settings:retractionLengthOnTra.effect: More may relieve pressure but worsen restart gaps or feed disturbance; less may reduce those disturbances while increasing ooze.
interactions: Extra matrix feed and route transitions
composite-settings:retractionLengthOnTra.caution: Do not use ordinary FFF retraction assumptions for continuous-fibre preparation or cutting. Exact eligibility requires output review.
composite-settings:retractionLengthOnTra.status: Functional interpretation; applicability and execution unverified.

composite-settings:retractionSpeed.meaning: The speed of matrix-plastic withdrawal during supported retraction events.
composite-settings:retractionSpeed.when_to_change: Only after a validated distance, when a supported experiment isolates withdrawal timing.
composite-settings:retractionSpeed.effect: Faster can relieve pressure sooner but increase feed demands; slower may be gentler but allow more ooze time.
interactions: Unretract speed and hardware feed limits
composite-settings:retractionSpeed.caution: A UI value is not a motor or pressure rating. This does not set continuous-fibre speed.
composite-settings:retractionSpeed.status: Functional interpretation; hardware limits not established.

composite-settings:temperatureOnFLs.meaning: The composite nozzle temperature requested during the initial printed height stage.
composite-settings:temperatureOnFLs.when_to_change: For a controlled initial deposition/adhesion comparison within both product and machine limits.
composite-settings:temperatureOnFLs.effect: Hotter can improve matrix wetting but increase ooze or degradation; cooler may sharpen features but weaken bonding or restrict flow.
interactions: Normal print temperature and loaded pair
composite-settings:temperatureOnFLs.caution: Do not copy an ordinary nozzle's accepted temperature as a composite acceptance result.

composite-settings:temperaturePreheat.meaning: The composite nozzle target associated with the enabled preheat stage.
composite-settings:temperaturePreheat.when_to_change: Only to follow the approved pair's supported preparation procedure.
composite-settings:temperaturePreheat.effect: A higher target adds preparation heat and may increase ooze; a lower target may reduce readiness or make feeding resistant.
interactions: Loading sequence, standby and printing temperatures
composite-settings:temperaturePreheat.caution: Do not feed a composite path before the OEM sequence permits it. A preheat target is not the steady deposition temperature.

composite-settings:temperaturePrint.meaning: The requested composite-nozzle temperature during normal deposition of the selected matrix/fibre pair.
composite-settings:temperaturePrint.when_to_change: During a controlled supported pair test, with flow, geometry and cooling fixed.
composite-settings:temperaturePrint.effect: Hotter generally lowers matrix viscosity but can increase ooze/degradation; cooler can reduce ooze while worsening wetting or backpressure.
interactions: Matrix product, route speed and flow
composite-settings:temperaturePrint.caution: The field does not certify a safe pressure or a dry/empty-fibre operation. Observe the supported loading and temperature limits.
composite-settings:temperaturePrint.status: Functional interpretation; physical tune not established.

composite-settings:temperatureWait.meaning: The standby nozzle target while the composite tool waits rather than normally depositing.
composite-settings:temperatureWait.when_to_change: During a verified tool-change/idle comparison using the approved pair and OEM sequence.
composite-settings:temperatureWait.effect: Lower standby heat may reduce ooze but lengthen recovery or make material resistant; higher may improve readiness but prolong heat exposure.
composite-settings:temperatureWait.caution: Standby is not a universal unloading temperature or permission to leave a stationary fibre in a hot tool indefinitely.

composite-settings:version.meaning: A version value attached to this composite-material definition.
composite-settings:version.when_to_change: Only according to the supported preset-management/versioning convention.
composite-settings:version.effect: May affect record comparison or migration; increasing it is not a material-quality improvement.
composite-settings:version.caution: The exact version semantics are unresolved. Do not use this alone as proof of a tuned revision or rename the application's version.
composite-settings:version.status: Version metadata interpretation; migration rules unresolved.

composite-settings:zHopF.meaning: The Z lift associated with the composite fibre restart, expressed in millimetres.
composite-settings:zHopF.when_to_change: Only in an OEM-supported restart/contact investigation with known tool offsets and route geometry.
composite-settings:zHopF.effect: A larger lift changes clearance and the subsequent restart approach; a smaller lift reduces that clearance. Exact motion ordering is not established.
interactions: Tool Z offsets and preparation contact
composite-settings:zHopF.caution: This is not ordinary plastic travel Z-hop. An incorrect change can alter fibre placement or cause contact/collision.

composite-settings:zHopFPauseAdhesion.meaning: A pause, in seconds, associated with composite restart adhesion.
composite-settings:zHopFPauseAdhesion.when_to_change: Only while qualifying a supported restart sequence and a specific matrix/fibre pair.
composite-settings:zHopFPauseAdhesion.effect: More pause changes contact/heat dwell and print time; less reduces dwell but may weaken restart attachment. The exact paused motion phase is unverified.
interactions: Temperature, matrix delivery and contact geometry
composite-settings:zHopFPauseAdhesion.caution: Do not extend dwell to hide a damaged or leaking nozzle. This is not a general minimum-layer-time cooling control.
composite-settings:zHopFPauseAdhesion.status: Label/context interpretation; exact dwell location unverified.

extruder-c-settings:cutCode.meaning: Executable G-code used for the composite cutter operation, not an explanatory note.
extruder-c-settings:cutCode.when_to_change: Only for a documented OEM hardware/firmware change with the entire cut/restart sequence reviewed.
extruder-c-settings:cutCode.effect: Different commands can move actuators, change tool state or feed material; a typo can invalidate a route or cause hardware contact.
extruder-c-settings:cutCode.caution: Preserve the OEM code. Never paste a generic servo/cutter command or old-unit code here to tune a filament symptom.
extruder-c-settings:cutCode.status: Hardware executable hook; not validated for modification.

extruder-c-settings:cutDistance.meaning: A composite-tool distance parameter associated with the cut and remaining route tail.
extruder-c-settings:cutDistance.when_to_change: Only after the actual cutter/feed geometry is measured through the supported hardware calibration procedure.
extruder-c-settings:cutDistance.effect: Changes can alter where cutting occurs relative to the route finish and how much strand remains. Exact sign and reference points are unverified here.
interactions: Fibre restart length and route-end treatment
extruder-c-settings:cutDistance.caution: Do not assume this is blade travel or borrow a historical cut-distance number as a new-machine value.

extruder-c-settings:fanIndex.meaning: Identifies which firmware fan channel is associated with the composite tool's cooling.
extruder-c-settings:fanIndex.when_to_change: Only to match verified OEM wiring or a documented supported hardware change.
extruder-c-settings:fanIndex.effect: Changing the index can route the same percentage request to a different physical fan, not simply increase its speed.
interactions: Firmware fan map and composite material cooling
extruder-c-settings:fanIndex.caution: A wrong index may drive the wrong device or disable required cooling. Confirm actual channel mapping; do not guess from another printer.
extruder-c-settings:fanIndex.status: Hardware mapping; must be independently verified.

extruder-c-settings:fiberRestartLength.meaning: A hardware restart length for feeding continuous fibre back into the composite operation.
extruder-c-settings:fiberRestartLength.when_to_change: Only through the supported fibre-path/cutter calibration for the actual installed assembly.
extruder-c-settings:fiberRestartLength.effect: Too much can overfeed or buckle strand; too little can leave a restart short of the intended location.
interactions: Restart feed speed, lift and pause
extruder-c-settings:fiberRestartLength.caution: Not an ordinary FFF retract/unretract length or a nozzle-diameter adjustment. Exact restart references must be established before editing.
extruder-c-settings:fiberRestartLength.status: Hardware restart interpretation; exact sequence unverified.

extruder-c-settings:hasFan.meaning: Declares that the composite tool has an assigned controllable cooling fan.
extruder-c-settings:hasFan.when_to_change: Only to match verified OEM tool hardware, not when comparing fan percentages.
extruder-c-settings:hasFan.effect: The declaration can enable or suppress cooling output for that tool; it does not physically add a fan.
extruder-c-settings:hasFan.caution: Do not disable a hardware capability to hide a failed fan. Protective heatsink cooling must remain as specified by the manufacturer.
extruder-c-settings:hasFan.status: Hardware capability declaration; runtime effect unvalidated.

extruder-c-settings:heatupSpeed.meaning: The composite tool's declared heating rate in degrees Celsius per second.
extruder-c-settings:heatupSpeed.when_to_change: Only when an OEM-supported hardware/timing calibration establishes the actual rate.
extruder-c-settings:heatupSpeed.effect: May affect heating-time prediction or scheduling. Entering a larger rate does not make the heater more powerful or prove faster heating is safe.
extruder-c-settings:heatupSpeed.caution: Exact scheduling use is unverified. Do not alter this to conceal thermal faults or replace firmware temperature-control calibration.
extruder-c-settings:heatupSpeed.status: Hardware timing parameter; exact algorithm unresolved.

extruder-c-settings:name.meaning: The descriptive name for a composite-tool definition.
extruder-c-settings:name.when_to_change: Only when managing a clearly identified hardware definition or its documented revision.
extruder-c-settings:name.effect: Improves human selection; renaming does not change the physical tool, firmware number or loading path.
extruder-c-settings:name.caution: Control type is unresolved. A T0 or 0.7 label alone cannot qualify routing or installed nozzle identity.
extruder-c-settings:name.status: Hardware metadata interpretation; control type unresolved.

extruder-c-settings:offsetX.meaning: The composite tool's X positional offset relative to the machine/tool reference.
extruder-c-settings:offsetX.when_to_change: Only during supported tool-alignment calibration for this physical machine.
extruder-c-settings:offsetX.effect: Changes where this tool's output aligns relative to other tools; it is not whole-part shrinkage compensation.
interactions: Firmware coordinate transforms and physical alignment
extruder-c-settings:offsetX.caution: Positive/negative application convention is not established here. A wrong offset can misregister material or cause a collision; preserve the OEM baseline.
extruder-c-settings:offsetX.status: Hardware coordinate parameter; direction convention unverified.

extruder-c-settings:offsetY.meaning: The composite tool's Y positional offset from its defined machine/tool reference.
extruder-c-settings:offsetY.when_to_change: Only when a supported physical tool-alignment procedure demonstrates a Y mismatch.
extruder-c-settings:offsetY.effect: Moves the tool's registration relative to other paths, not just a printed hole's diameter.
extruder-c-settings:offsetY.caution: Do not guess the sign or copy the retained machine's value. Verify the reference frame before any resulting motion.
extruder-c-settings:offsetY.status: Hardware coordinate parameter; direction convention unverified.

extruder-c-settings:offsetZ.meaning: The composite tool's vertical relationship to the machine/tool reference.
extruder-c-settings:offsetZ.when_to_change: Only during supported tool-height/contact calibration after mechanical inspection.
extruder-c-settings:offsetZ.effect: Changes vertical registration/contact. An incorrect value can press the tool into the plate or leave deposition unattached.
interactions: First-layer geometry and composite restart contact
extruder-c-settings:offsetZ.caution: This is not a filament-flow adjustment. Sign and reference must be verified; do not repair a nozzle leak or bed defect by changing Z offset.
extruder-c-settings:offsetZ.status: Hardware coordinate parameter; not qualified for casual editing.

extruder-p-settings:fanIndex.meaning: The firmware fan channel associated with the ordinary plastic tool's cooling.
extruder-p-settings:fanIndex.when_to_change: Only to match independently verified OEM wiring or a supported tool change.
extruder-p-settings:fanIndex.effect: Selects a device channel; it is not a percentage or a fan power limit.
interactions: Plastic material fan schedule and firmware mapping
extruder-p-settings:fanIndex.caution: A wrong channel can command another fan or leave the intended fan off. Do not derive the index from the composite tool's name.

extruder-p-settings:hasFan.meaning: Declares that the ordinary plastic tool has a controllable cooling fan.
extruder-p-settings:hasFan.when_to_change: Only when accurately defining supported installed hardware.
extruder-p-settings:hasFan.effect: May govern whether material cooling commands are generated; toggling it does not repair or install a fan.
interactions: Enable print cooling and material schedule
extruder-p-settings:hasFan.caution: Do not use this declaration to bypass a cooling fault or disable protective hotend cooling.
extruder-p-settings:hasFan.status: Hardware capability declaration; actual output unvalidated.

extruder-p-settings:heatupSpeed.meaning: The ordinary plastic tool's declared heating rate in degrees Celsius per second.
extruder-p-settings:heatupSpeed.when_to_change: Only following supported hardware timing/calibration evidence, not for each spool.
extruder-p-settings:heatupSpeed.effect: May change heating predictions or scheduling; a larger declared number does not change heater wattage or guarantee thermal readiness.
extruder-p-settings:heatupSpeed.caution: Do not falsify this to get past a thermal delay or fault. Exact use by the scheduler is not verified.
extruder-p-settings:heatupSpeed.status: Hardware timing interpretation; exact algorithm unresolved.

extruder-p-settings:name.meaning: The human-readable name of the ordinary plastic-tool definition.
extruder-p-settings:name.when_to_change: When maintaining a clearly scoped supported hardware definition or revision.
extruder-p-settings:name.effect: Helps identification; a renamed definition does not prove which physical hotend will execute the job.
extruder-p-settings:name.caution: Control type is unresolved. Tool labels and firmware identifiers must still be matched to hardware.
extruder-p-settings:name.status: Hardware metadata interpretation; control type unresolved.

extruder-p-settings:nozzleDiameter.meaning: The declared outlet diameter of the installed ordinary plastic nozzle, in millimetres.
extruder-p-settings:nozzleDiameter.when_to_change: After physically verifying a supported nozzle replacement or correcting a demonstrated wrong definition.
extruder-p-settings:nozzleDiameter.effect: Can affect allowed/planned line geometry. Changing the number cannot make the installed opening larger or qualify an abrasive material.
interactions: Flow, physical nozzle wear and compatible profiles
extruder-p-settings:nozzleDiameter.caution: Never tune this as an extrusion multiplier. A wrong diameter invalidates downstream tests; keep separate nozzle-specific records.
extruder-p-settings:nozzleDiameter.status: Physical hardware declaration; installed size must be verified.

extruder-p-settings:offsetX.meaning: The ordinary plastic tool's X alignment offset from the defined tool/machine reference.
extruder-p-settings:offsetX.when_to_change: Only through supported physical tool-alignment calibration.
extruder-p-settings:offsetX.effect: Changes registration of this tool relative to other tools, not material shrinkage or model scale.
extruder-p-settings:offsetX.caution: The sign convention is not established by the label. Incorrect offsets can misplace material or collide with machine fixtures.
extruder-p-settings:offsetX.status: Hardware coordinate parameter; direction convention unverified.

extruder-p-settings:offsetY.meaning: The ordinary plastic tool's Y alignment offset relative to its reference.
extruder-p-settings:offsetY.when_to_change: When a supported tool-alignment measurement establishes an actual Y offset error.
extruder-p-settings:offsetY.effect: Changes where that tool registers in Y relative to other deposition and preparation operations.
interactions: Firmware coordinate transforms and tool preparation
extruder-p-settings:offsetY.caution: Do not copy the other machine's value or guess the correction sign from a photograph.
extruder-p-settings:offsetY.status: Hardware coordinate parameter; exact transform unverified.

extruder-p-settings:offsetZ.meaning: The ordinary plastic nozzle's vertical alignment relative to the selected machine/tool reference.
extruder-p-settings:offsetZ.when_to_change: Only during supported tool-height/probing calibration after checking physical hardware and plate seating.
extruder-p-settings:offsetZ.effect: An incorrect change can cause scraping or poor attachment even if the material multiplier is correct.
extruder-p-settings:offsetZ.caution: Not a universal first-layer-flow fix. Verify the sign/reference and use the OEM calibration method, not trial nozzle contact.
extruder-p-settings:offsetZ.status: Hardware coordinate parameter; not qualified for casual editing.

plastic-settings:bedTemperature.meaning: The normal printing target for the build plate, in degrees Celsius.
plastic-settings:bedTemperature.when_to_change: During a controlled adhesion/thermal comparison after plate preparation and first-layer geometry are reliable.
plastic-settings:bedTemperature.effect: Higher can improve attachment but soften or enlarge the bottom; lower can reduce those effects but increase lifting.
interactions: Plate coating, adhesive and chamber condition
plastic-settings:bedTemperature.caution: Stay within both plate and material guidance. More bed heat is not a repair for contamination or a loose plate.

plastic-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.meaning: The build-plate target during the initial-layer stage, separate from the normal bed target.
plastic-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.when_to_change: For initial adhesion comparisons with the same plate, cleaning and nozzle-to-plate relationship.
plastic-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.effect: More initial heat can improve wetting but increase bottom flare; less may sharpen the bottom while reducing attachment.
interactions: Initial nozzle temperature and first-layer geometry
plastic-settings:bedTemperatureOnFLs.caution: The exact stage transition must be confirmed; do not assume this uses the same trigger as every other first-layers field.

plastic-settings:chamberTemperature.meaning: The requested chamber temperature for this plastic where active chamber heating is supported.
plastic-settings:chamberTemperature.when_to_change: When qualifying the material's enclosure conditions under current product and printer guidance.
plastic-settings:chamberTemperature.effect: Warmer conditions may reduce contraction and splitting but can worsen heat creep or small details; cooler can do the reverse.
interactions: Exhaust, part cooling and ambient conditions
plastic-settings:chamberTemperature.caution: A number in the profile does not prove the heater/sensor works or that the chamber reached it. Do not change hardware flags to force it.
plastic-settings:chamberTemperature.status: Functional interpretation; actual chamber operation unvalidated.

plastic-settings:coastAtEndLength.meaning: A length at the end of a plastic path associated with coasting: using remaining pressure instead of continuing ordinary feed.
plastic-settings:coastAtEndLength.when_to_change: Only after baseline extrusion is stable and repeated line ends show a specific pressure-related buildup.
plastic-settings:coastAtEndLength.effect: More coasting can reduce an end blob but leave a thin or open finish; less can restore the finish while leaving excess pressure.
interactions: Flow multiplier and effective pressure behaviour
plastic-settings:coastAtEndLength.caution: It is not a substitute for supported PA calibration. The exact path-length convention and eligible features remain unverified.
plastic-settings:coastAtEndLength.status: Label-based coasting interpretation; exact planning unverified.

plastic-settings:color.meaning: The colour used to represent this material in the application.
plastic-settings:color.when_to_change: To identify the intended spool visually and distinguish material candidates.
plastic-settings:color.effect: Changes a swatch/representation, not physical filament colour, loading or tuning.
plastic-settings:color.caution: Real colour variants can need different tuning. A changed swatch is not validation of a different formulation.

plastic-settings:costPerSpool.meaning: Purchase price for the plastic spool in the selected currency.
plastic-settings:costPerSpool.when_to_change: When recording a different price or supplied spool product.
plastic-settings:costPerSpool.effect: Can change estimated job cost without changing the printed toolpath or material's quality.
plastic-settings:costPerSpool.caution: The currency placeholder is dynamic. Cost is not a feed-rate, temperature or material-compatibility setting.
plastic-settings:costPerSpool.status: Accounting interpretation; exact cost calculation unverified.

plastic-settings:density.meaning: The material's mass per volume, expressed by this schema in grams per cubic centimetre.
plastic-settings:density.when_to_change: To accurately define the product from manufacturer data or a reliable material measurement.
plastic-settings:density.effect: Changes the relationship between estimated volume and mass; increasing density is not the same as increasing commanded flow.
plastic-settings:density.caution: Do not alter density to disguise an extrusion fault. Exact uses beyond material accounting are not established here.
plastic-settings:density.status: Unit-backed material interpretation; downstream use unverified.

plastic-settings:description.meaning: Notes associated with this plastic-material definition.
plastic-settings:description.when_to_change: To record conditioning, physical scope, test status, limitations and evidence references.
plastic-settings:description.effect: Makes a candidate understandable to another operator, but does not enforce the values or instructions written in it.
plastic-settings:description.caution: Keep credentials and private identifiers out of exported notes. A written TUNED claim needs actual supporting tests.
plastic-settings:description.status: Schema-backed notes field; not an enforcement mechanism.

plastic-settings:enablePreheat.meaning: Enables the material's separately configured nozzle preheat behaviour.
plastic-settings:enablePreheat.when_to_change: Only when the supported workflow needs that preparation stage or a documented comparison addresses it.
plastic-settings:enablePreheat.effect: May request the preheat target before normal printing. Disabled does not mean firmware preparation or other heating commands disappear.
interactions: Printer start code and standby scheduling
plastic-settings:enablePreheat.caution: Do not use the switch to bypass supported preparation or heat-safety checks. Exact waits and timing are unverified.

plastic-settings:enablePrintCooling.meaning: Allows the material's part-cooling schedule to operate its assigned fan.
plastic-settings:enablePrintCooling.when_to_change: For a controlled cooling comparison after establishing the correct fan and material baseline.
plastic-settings:enablePrintCooling.effect: Allows initial/regular/maximum cooling requests where applicable. Disabling does not prove every physical fan will stop.
interactions: Initial, regular and maximum fan speeds
Physical fan mapping and feature overrides
plastic-settings:enablePrintCooling.caution: Do not stop hotend-protection cooling. Verify effective fan commands instead of equating this switch with all fan behaviour.
plastic-settings:enablePrintCooling.status: Functional interpretation; complete fan lifecycle unvalidated.

plastic-settings:extraLengthP.meaning: Extra plastic feed added around unretraction beyond restoring the amount withdrawn.
plastic-settings:extraLengthP.when_to_change: Only when an isolated restart test shows a genuine shortage after moisture, temperature and retraction are stable.
plastic-settings:extraLengthP.effect: More can fill a lean start but add a blob; less can reduce excess at starts while risking a gap.
interactions: Unretract speed, coasting and pressure recovery
plastic-settings:extraLengthP.caution: Do not raise this to compensate for a blocked feed path. Confirm the exact restart application in output.
plastic-settings:extraLengthP.status: Label-based restart interpretation; exact application unverified.

plastic-settings:extraLengthPOnToolChang.meaning: Additional plastic feed specifically associated with returning after a tool change.
plastic-settings:extraLengthPOnToolChang.when_to_change: When a tool-change test shows a repeatable return deficit that does not occur on ordinary travel.
plastic-settings:extraLengthPOnToolChang.effect: More can restore a lean return but create a blob; less can reduce over-prime while leaving the next path underfed.
plastic-settings:extraLengthPOnToolChang.caution: Ordinary travel and tool-change recovery are separate events. Do not copy this value into composite fibre restart settings.
plastic-settings:extraLengthPOnToolChang.status: Functional interpretation; full tool lifecycle unvalidated.

plastic-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.meaning: Scales the amount of ordinary plastic Rocket requests. This is a dimensionless material multiplier, not speed or pressure advance.
plastic-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.when_to_change: During a supported top-surface flow comparison below the usable melt limit, after temperature is stable.
plastic-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.effect: Higher deposits more material and can close channels or cause ridges; lower deposits less and can remove ridges or create gaps.
interactions: Speed, melt capacity and feature-specific flow
plastic-settings:extrusionMultiplierP.caution: Do not tune it from first-layer appearance alone or use it as whole-part dimensional compensation. Verify the saved ratio, not a borrowed tile label.

plastic-settings:extrusionSpeedP.meaning: Unretract speed: how fast the feeder restores withdrawn plastic, not normal model-printing speed.
plastic-settings:extrusionSpeedP.when_to_change: After retract distance is established, when isolating a pressure-recovery timing problem.
plastic-settings:extrusionSpeedP.effect: Faster can restore pressure sooner but increase feed demand; slower may reduce surges while delaying the next clean line.
plastic-settings:extrusionSpeedP.caution: Do not set this from travel speed or the hotend's volumetric limit alone; standalone feed behaviour differs from coordinated deposition.
plastic-settings:extrusionSpeedP.status: Functional interpretation; actual feed response unvalidated.

plastic-settings:filamentDiameter.meaning: The incoming plastic filament's diameter, not the nozzle opening.
plastic-settings:filamentDiameter.when_to_change: For an accurately defined supported filament or a confirmed entry error, using representative measurements where appropriate.
plastic-settings:filamentDiameter.effect: Diameter affects the relationship between requested volume and feed length; a larger declared diameter generally needs less length for the same volume.
plastic-settings:filamentDiameter.caution: Do not falsify diameter as a flow-tuning shortcut. A changed nominal field does not make another filament size fit the extruder.
plastic-settings:filamentDiameter.status: Functional material interpretation; exact conversion unverified.

plastic-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.meaning: The initial cooling-stage height in millimetres, not a numbered layer count.
plastic-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.when_to_change: When comparing how long early-layer cooling should persist after a reliable adhesion baseline.
plastic-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.effect: A greater height extends the initial fan condition; a smaller height moves to later cooling earlier.
interactions: Layer height, regular cooling and adhesion
plastic-settings:firstLayersFanHeight.caution: Check actual boundary behaviour in output. This setting does not establish the nozzle- or bed-temperature transition by itself.

plastic-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.meaning: Part-cooling percentage requested during the material's initial cooling-height stage.
plastic-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.when_to_change: For a one-variable early-layer attachment/curl comparison using the same plate preparation.
plastic-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.effect: More can cool edges and sharpen detail but weaken adhesion; less keeps the initial region hotter and may soften features.
interactions: Bed, chamber and normal fan settings
plastic-settings:firstLayersFanSpeed.caution: This percentage is not measured airflow and is not the protective heatsink fan setting.

plastic-settings:firstLayersHeight.meaning: The printed height over which the material's initial nozzle temperature applies.
plastic-settings:firstLayersHeight.when_to_change: When isolating the duration of the initial thermal condition after first-layer geometry is correct.
plastic-settings:firstLayersHeight.effect: Increasing extends the initial target in height; decreasing moves toward the regular printing target sooner.
plastic-settings:firstLayersHeight.caution: Units are millimetres, not layers. Do not assume importing a tower or changing this field creates a multi-temperature sweep.

plastic-settings:layerTimeForMaxCooling.meaning: A layer-duration threshold in seconds associated with using the maximum fan setting on short layers.
plastic-settings:layerTimeForMaxCooling.when_to_change: When a controlled small-feature test shows insufficient cooling or unnecessary fan variation.
plastic-settings:layerTimeForMaxCooling.effect: A larger threshold can make more layers qualify as short; a smaller one can reserve maximum cooling for shorter layers. Exact interpolation is unverified.
interactions: Actual layer duration and cooling enable
plastic-settings:layerTimeForMaxCooling.caution: Do not assume this slows the print to that duration. It is labelled as a fan threshold, not proof of a minimum-layer-time speed control.
plastic-settings:layerTimeForMaxCooling.status: Label-based cooling-threshold interpretation; exact curve unverified.

plastic-settings:manufacturer.meaning: The supplier/manufacturer identity of the plastic material.
plastic-settings:manufacturer.when_to_change: To accurately identify the actual product and distinguish another manufacturer's candidate.
plastic-settings:manufacturer.effect: Supports traceability; a brand label alone does not set or validate temperature, flow or compatibility.
plastic-settings:manufacturer.caution: The editor control type is unresolved. Do not treat two products with the same polymer name as equivalent tunes.

plastic-settings:maximumFanSpeed.meaning: The maximum part-cooling percentage used by the material's normal cooling logic, particularly on short layers.
plastic-settings:maximumFanSpeed.when_to_change: When testing small-feature cooling while checking layer bonding and warp resistance.
plastic-settings:maximumFanSpeed.effect: Higher can improve tiny features but overcool bonding or cause warping; lower may improve bonding while leaving soft or curled detail.
plastic-settings:maximumFanSpeed.caution: Do not assume this caps every bridge, machine or manually emitted fan request. Review the actual cooling sequence.
plastic-settings:maximumFanSpeed.status: Cooling interpretation; global fan-cap semantics unverified.

plastic-settings:name.meaning: The human-readable identity of this ordinary plastic-material definition.
plastic-settings:name.when_to_change: When creating a scoped candidate or revised material record for the real machine/nozzle/product.
plastic-settings:name.effect: Makes the intended choice distinguishable; it does not enforce compatibility or move a spool into the printer.
interactions: Material revision and physical spool record
plastic-settings:name.caution: Accepted name characters/control type are unresolved. A typed TUNED label is not evidence of completed validation.

plastic-settings:plasticType.meaning: The material-family classification of the ordinary plastic.
plastic-settings:plasticType.when_to_change: Only to identify the real supported product or correct its classification.
plastic-settings:plasticType.effect: May participate in selection/category matching; it does not independently establish the physical material's safe settings.
plastic-settings:plasticType.caution: Control type/options and exact matching behaviour are unresolved. Relabelling a material does not make it compatible.

plastic-settings:regularFanSpeed.meaning: The ordinary part-cooling percentage used outside the initial cooling stage and special cooling conditions.
plastic-settings:regularFanSpeed.when_to_change: During a fixed-temperature cooling comparison on representative walls and features.
plastic-settings:regularFanSpeed.effect: More can improve deposited shape but reduce bonding or promote warp; less keeps heat and can improve bonding while softening detail.
plastic-settings:regularFanSpeed.caution: Normal fan is not proof of bridge fan or every executed fan command. Confirm the correct physical fan and output.

plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelNoC.meaning: The travel-length threshold associated with retraction when the travel stays inside the part rather than crossing its boundary.
plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelNoC.when_to_change: When a controlled toolpath review identifies unnecessary short internal retractions or ooze during longer internal travels.
plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelNoC.effect: Higher generally leaves more short internal moves unretracted; lower can add retractions and restart events.
plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelNoC.caution: This is a trigger distance, not the amount of filament pulled back. Exact boundary classification must be checked in output.
plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelNoC.status: Label-based travel-trigger interpretation; exact classifier unverified.

plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelOnC.meaning: The travel-length threshold for retraction when the path crosses the part boundary/open space.
plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelOnC.when_to_change: When realistic crossing travels show strings or repeated restarts from excessive triggering.
plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelOnC.effect: Lower can retract on more short crossings; higher can reduce events but leave more unretracted ooze time.
plastic-settings:retractMinimumTravelOnC.caution: Do not confuse the threshold with withdrawal length. A travel that looks nearby can follow a different actual route.

plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnToolC.meaning: Plastic withdrawal distance used around changing away from this tool.
plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnToolC.when_to_change: Only for a supported tool-change comparison, after ordinary travel behaviour is separately established.
plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnToolC.effect: More can reduce idle ooze but increase recovery demand or feed problems; less may ease recovery but allow dripping.
plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnToolC.caution: Not a full filament-unload distance or an ordinary travel default. Do not copy it to a continuous-fibre path.
plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnToolC.status: Functional interpretation; complete change-tool behaviour unvalidated.

plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnTrave.meaning: The plastic length withdrawn for an eligible ordinary non-printing move.
plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnTrave.when_to_change: After drying/temperature are stable, to compare supported distances while holding retract speed fixed.
plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnTrave.effect: More can reduce strings but cause lean restarts or feed/clog problems; less reduces those demands but may leave thicker strings.
interactions: Retract/unretract speeds, extra feed and temperature
plastic-settings:retractionLengthOnTrave.caution: Choose the shortest repeatably useful distance within hardware guidance. Retraction cannot repair moisture, a leaking joint or a partial blockage.

plastic-settings:retractionSpeed.meaning: How fast plastic is withdrawn during ordinary retraction, in millimetres of filament per second.
plastic-settings:retractionSpeed.when_to_change: After distance is stable, when an isolated test addresses withdrawal timing or feeder response.
plastic-settings:retractionSpeed.effect: Faster can relieve pressure sooner but demand more grip/acceleration; slower can be gentler while leaving more ooze time.
interactions: Unretract speed and hardware feeder capability
plastic-settings:retractionSpeed.caution: A permitted UI number is not proof that the motor, filament or hotend can safely follow it.

plastic-settings:spoolWeight.meaning: The spool's material quantity recorded in grams for estimates.
plastic-settings:spoolWeight.when_to_change: When accurately defining a different supplied spool size, using the application's intended mass convention.
plastic-settings:spoolWeight.effect: Can affect cost/capacity reporting, not normal line width or requested print speed.
plastic-settings:spoolWeight.caution: Net filament versus total spool convention is unresolved here. Do not assume entered capacity proves enough physical filament remains.

plastic-settings:temperatureOnFLs.meaning: The nozzle target during the material's initial printed-height stage.
plastic-settings:temperatureOnFLs.when_to_change: For a controlled first-layer wetting/adhesion comparison after nozzle height and plate preparation are correct.
plastic-settings:temperatureOnFLs.effect: Higher can improve wetting but add ooze or bottom distortion; lower may sharpen detail but weaken attachment or flow.
interactions: Normal nozzle and initial bed targets
plastic-settings:temperatureOnFLs.caution: Keep within the real material/machine limits. A hotter first layer does not fix a nozzle scraping the plate.
plastic-settings:temperatureOnFLs.status: Functional interpretation; physical initial layer unvalidated.

plastic-settings:temperaturePreheat.meaning: The nozzle temperature requested for the enabled preheat stage.
plastic-settings:temperaturePreheat.when_to_change: Only to match the supported preparation requirements of the actual material and machine.
plastic-settings:temperaturePreheat.effect: A higher target can improve readiness but increase ooze and heat exposure; a lower one can reduce ooze while delaying readiness.
plastic-settings:temperaturePreheat.caution: It is not automatically the printing temperature or a safe manual load temperature. Confirm supported waits before feeding.

plastic-settings:temperaturePrint.meaning: The normal nozzle temperature requested for this plastic during deposition.
plastic-settings:temperaturePrint.when_to_change: During fixed-setting temperature coupons with geometry, flow and cooling held constant.
plastic-settings:temperaturePrint.effect: Higher generally improves melting/adhesion at flow but may increase strings, softness or degradation; lower may sharpen detail while restricting melting/bonding.
plastic-settings:temperaturePrint.caution: Start within current product and machine guidance. A low-speed attractive sample does not prove high-flow strength.

plastic-settings:temperatureWait.meaning: The nozzle standby target while the tool waits instead of normally printing.
plastic-settings:temperatureWait.when_to_change: For a supported idle/tool-change comparison after recording the actual sequence.
plastic-settings:temperatureWait.effect: Lower can reduce ooze but delay reheating or make recovery resistant; higher keeps readiness but adds thermal dwell and ooze.
plastic-settings:temperatureWait.caution: Do not treat standby as an unloading or maintenance temperature without the manufacturer's procedure.

plastic-settings:version.meaning: A version value belonging to this material definition.
plastic-settings:version.when_to_change: Only according to the supported preset-management convention when a definition is revised.
plastic-settings:version.effect: May affect comparison/import/migration, not physical material quality or firmware version.
plastic-settings:version.caution: Exact migration semantics are unresolved. Keep a human-readable revision/evidence record rather than treating a larger number as validation.
plastic-settings:version.status: Version metadata interpretation; exact rules unresolved.

plastic-settings:wipeNozzleLength.meaning: The distance associated with wiping the nozzle along a path near retraction or a road ending.
plastic-settings:wipeNozzleLength.when_to_change: After baseline flow is stable, if an isolated seam/end test identifies excess residual material.
plastic-settings:wipeNozzleLength.effect: A longer wipe can spread/remove residue but thin the finish or add marks; a shorter one reduces that treatment but may leave a blob.
interactions: Retraction, coast length and seam location
Actual wipe path and pressure behaviour
plastic-settings:wipeNozzleLength.caution: This label does not establish use of the machine's physical cleaning station. Exact path/timing must be checked in output.

plastic-settings:zHopP.meaning: The Z lift used for applicable ordinary plastic travel/retraction moves.
plastic-settings:zHopP.when_to_change: Only when a demonstrated clearance problem remains after checking part lift, overextrusion and travel routing.
plastic-settings:zHopP.effect: More can clear raised features but adds Z motion, time and ooze opportunity; less reduces those costs while reducing clearance.
interactions: Z motion limits and part condition
plastic-settings:zHopP.caution: Do not use Z-hop to hide nozzle scraping, failed probing or a lifting part. It is separate from composite restart lift.
plastic-settings:zHopP.status: Functional interpretation; eligibility and physical clearance unvalidated.

printer-settings:additionalRetract.meaning: A printer-level additional withdrawal distance, separate from the material's ordinary retract length.
printer-settings:additionalRetract.when_to_change: Only after identifying its exact supported use in this printer's preparation/tool-change lifecycle.
printer-settings:additionalRetract.effect: More withdrawal can increase the amount later requiring recovery; less can leave more material/pressure in that stage. The exact triggering stage is unresolved.
printer-settings:additionalRetract.caution: Do not add it blindly to cure stringing. Printer-level and material-level withdrawals may combine; inspect complete output first.
printer-settings:additionalRetract.status: Label-based hardware interpretation; exact trigger unresolved.

printer-settings:blocksBufferSize.meaning: A machine/planner block-buffer setting, apparently related to how many motion blocks are handled ahead of execution.
printer-settings:blocksBufferSize.when_to_change: Only under a documented OEM firmware/planner procedure, not ordinary filament tuning.
printer-settings:blocksBufferSize.effect: A different value may change planning assumptions or output pacing. The unit, allocation and actual enforcement are not established by this label.
printer-settings:blocksBufferSize.caution: More is not automatically smoother or safer, and this is not a network upload buffer. Preserve the OEM value until semantics are verified.

printer-settings:bottomIntermediateSolid.meaning: The acceleration request for solid bottom layers other than the outermost bottom skin, according to the role label.
printer-settings:bottomIntermediateSolid.when_to_change: Only in a controlled motion comparison after basic material and mechanical behaviour are stable.
printer-settings:bottomIntermediateSolid.effect: Higher can shorten internal bottom-fill motion but increase pressure changes/vibration; lower can smooth motion while adding time.
interactions: Acceleration enable, regular acceleration and firmware limits
printer-settings:bottomIntermediateSolid.caution: Bottom Middle is a feature role, not necessarily a numbered physical layer or the bed-contact first layer. Verify preview/output targeting.

printer-settings:bottomMostSolidInfillAc.meaning: The acceleration request for the outermost bottom solid-surface role.
printer-settings:bottomMostSolidInfillAc.when_to_change: When separately validating bottom-surface motion and attachment with first-layer geometry already correct.
printer-settings:bottomMostSolidInfillAc.effect: Lower can make short bottom paths gentler but slower; higher can reduce time while increasing dynamic feed and attachment demands.
interactions: First-layer rules, acceleration enable and firmware limits
printer-settings:bottomMostSolidInfillAc.caution: Do not equate this role with all first-layer motion or use acceleration to hide a nozzle-height error.
printer-settings:bottomMostSolidInfillAc.status: Role-label interpretation; actual override precedence unverified.

printer-settings:bridgeSolidInfillAccele.meaning: The acceleration request for bridge solid-infill paths.
printer-settings:bridgeSolidInfillAccele.when_to_change: During a controlled bridge-motion comparison after temperature, anchors and bridge flow are credible.
printer-settings:bridgeSolidInfillAccele.effect: Higher changes tension and pressure faster at bridge starts/ends; lower can soften those transitions but change time spent over the unsupported span.
printer-settings:bridgeSolidInfillAccele.caution: Acceleration is not bridge speed or a strength rating. Verify the bridge role actually receives this request.
printer-settings:bridgeSolidInfillAccele.status: Functional role interpretation; physical bridge result unvalidated.

printer-settings:brimAcceleration.meaning: The acceleration request while printing the brim attached around a part's base.
printer-settings:brimAcceleration.when_to_change: For a controlled adhesion/motion comparison with clean plate and correct brim geometry.
printer-settings:brimAcceleration.effect: Lower can make short adhesion paths gentler; higher may reduce time but challenge attachment and pressure consistency.
printer-settings:brimAcceleration.caution: A gentler brim cannot fix a dirty plate or a gap that prevents it joining the part.

printer-settings:cellularInfillAccelerat.meaning: The acceleration request for ordinary plastic sparse-infill paths, not continuous-fibre infill.
printer-settings:cellularInfillAccelerat.when_to_change: When balancing internal-fill time against motion stability after the melt envelope is established.
printer-settings:cellularInfillAccelerat.effect: Higher can help short infill segments reach speed but increase vibration/feed transients; lower may improve stability while extending print time.
printer-settings:cellularInfillAccelerat.caution: An internal feature is not permission to exceed feeder or machine capability. This does not tune fibre-route acceleration.

printer-settings:chamberHeatupSpeed.meaning: The declared chamber heating rate in degrees Celsius per second.
printer-settings:chamberHeatupSpeed.when_to_change: Only after an OEM-supported measurement/calibration establishes the machine's thermal timing.
printer-settings:chamberHeatupSpeed.effect: May alter heat-up predictions or scheduling. A larger entered rate does not increase heater power or establish a stable soaked chamber.
printer-settings:chamberHeatupSpeed.caution: Not a thermal-protection setting or remedy for a failed sensor. Exact scheduler use is unverified.
printer-settings:chamberHeatupSpeed.status: Hardware timing interpretation; exact implementation unresolved.

printer-settings:defaultAccelerationE.meaning: The printer definition's baseline acceleration value for the E material-feed axis.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationE.when_to_change: Only to match verified supported feeder/firmware capability through machine calibration.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationE.effect: A higher request can change feed-speed transitions but increase grip/motor demands; lower can slow pressure recovery or alter timing.
interactions: Material retraction, pressure behaviour and firmware axis mapping
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationE.caution: Do not assume E is interchangeable with composite V/U/P axes or that this is a hard firmware maximum. Exact command mapping needs review.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationE.status: Machine-axis interpretation; mapping and enforcement unverified.

printer-settings:defaultAccelerationRetr.meaning: The machine's baseline acceleration request for retraction-related feed motion.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationRetr.when_to_change: Only under a supported feeder/motion calibration after the exact retraction path is known.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationRetr.effect: Higher can make withdrawals/restorations more abrupt; lower can make them gentler but change their duration and pressure response.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationRetr.caution: A slicer entry is not a safe mechanical rating. Do not use it to force a stalled or obstructed filament path.

printer-settings:defaultAccelerationX.meaning: The baseline X-axis acceleration declared in the printer definition.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationX.when_to_change: Only after supported machine-motion evidence or an OEM configuration change, not for one spool's flow defect.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationX.effect: Higher can permit more abrupt X speed changes but increase vibration or step loss; lower can reduce those loads while extending motion time.
interactions: Firmware motion limits and X jerk
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationX.caution: The field's emitted/limit role must be verified; it is not proof the printer can sustain the requested acceleration.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationX.status: Machine-axis interpretation; exact firmware role unverified.

printer-settings:defaultAccelerationY.meaning: The printer definition's baseline Y-axis acceleration.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationY.when_to_change: Only during supported mechanical/motion qualification or to match a verified OEM baseline.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationY.effect: Higher can reduce time on short Y-related moves but add dynamic loads; lower can improve stability while slowing those moves.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationY.caution: Cartesian axis labels do not identify one CoreXY motor. Do not change this to mask an axis-specific dimensional fault.

printer-settings:defaultAccelerationZ.meaning: The baseline acceleration value declared for vertical Z motion.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationZ.when_to_change: Only under supported machine calibration after checking the actual Z mechanism and firmware limits.
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationZ.effect: Higher can make lifts/layer transitions more abrupt; lower softens them but can add travel time.
interactions: Tool-change lifts, bed motion and probing
printer-settings:defaultAccelerationZ.caution: Do not copy XY acceleration into Z or use this as a nozzle-height correction. Unsupported Z motion can cause collisions or registration loss.

printer-settings:defaultJerkE.meaning: The feed-axis jerk-style baseline expressed by the schema as a speed, not acceleration per second.
printer-settings:defaultJerkE.when_to_change: Only with a verified definition of how this OEM firmware interprets the emitted setting.
printer-settings:defaultJerkE.effect: Depending on firmware, higher can allow sharper feed transitions and lower can soften them; neither equals pressure advance.
printer-settings:defaultJerkE.caution: Classic jerk, junction deviation and square-corner velocity are not interchangeable. Do not assume a composite-axis mapping or portable numeric value.

printer-settings:defaultJerkX.meaning: A baseline X jerk-style motion value, expressed in speed units in this schema.
printer-settings:defaultJerkX.when_to_change: Only after verifying the OEM firmware's cornering model and supported machine procedure.
printer-settings:defaultJerkX.effect: A larger value can allow more abrupt corner transitions; a smaller value can slow corners and change pressure/time.
interactions: Feature jerk requests and firmware cornering rules
printer-settings:defaultJerkX.caution: Do not translate this blindly into Klipper square-corner velocity or another firmware's jerk. It is not a material-flow multiplier.
printer-settings:defaultJerkX.status: Firmware-dependent cornering interpretation; actual mapping unverified.

printer-settings:defaultJerkY.meaning: The Y baseline jerk-style value in the printer definition.
printer-settings:defaultJerkY.when_to_change: Only through supported motion qualification with the effective firmware interpretation known.
printer-settings:defaultJerkY.effect: Higher may carry more speed through corners but increase disturbance; lower may soften direction changes while adding time and heat dwell.
