printer-settings:defaultJerkY.caution: Speed units do not establish identical meaning across firmware families. Avoid arbitrary axis-by-axis changes to chase surface texture.

printer-settings:defaultJerkZ.meaning: The Z-axis baseline jerk-style value, shown in speed units.
printer-settings:defaultJerkZ.when_to_change: Only under the OEM vertical-motion calibration/definition, not as an ordinary material setting.
printer-settings:defaultJerkZ.effect: May change abruptness of Z transitions depending on firmware; more is not automatically faster or more accurate.
printer-settings:defaultJerkZ.caution: Do not borrow XY values or assume this is physical Z clearance. Verify command interpretation before modifying it.
printer-settings:defaultJerkZ.status: Firmware-dependent hardware parameter; exact behaviour unresolved.

printer-settings:description.meaning: Notes describing the printer template and its intended hardware/configuration.
printer-settings:description.when_to_change: To record known hardware, supported versions, evidence and limitations while preserving the factory reference.
printer-settings:description.effect: Improves traceability but does not apply a hardware change or verify a private connection target.
printer-settings:description.caution: Keep private addresses, credentials and serials out of shared exports. A claimed nozzle or safety feature still needs physical evidence.
printer-settings:description.status: Schema-backed notes field; not an enforcement mechanism.

printer-settings:doUnretractBeforeToolCh.meaning: Requests unretraction before a tool-change operation rather than leaving the previous retracted state untouched.
printer-settings:doUnretractBeforeToolCh.when_to_change: Only when the exact OEM change-tool sequence and material-state bookkeeping are understood.
printer-settings:doUnretractBeforeToolCh.effect: Can add a restoration feed before changing tools, affecting ooze and the next stage's expected state.
interactions: Additional retract and before/after change code
printer-settings:doUnretractBeforeToolCh.caution: Do not toggle it as a generic stringing fix. Duplicate or missing recovery can create unexpected feed; composite loading is not ordinary unretraction.
printer-settings:doUnretractBeforeToolCh.status: Label-based lifecycle interpretation; exact sequencing unverified.

printer-settings:endGCode.meaning: Executable commands appended for the end-of-job procedure.
printer-settings:endGCode.when_to_change: Only for a documented supported printer workflow change with the entire completion/failure lifecycle reviewed.
printer-settings:endGCode.effect: Can change parking, heaters, fans, material handling and final machine state; it is not merely a message printed in a file.
printer-settings:endGCode.caution: Preserve OEM code. An otherwise successful part can end with a dangerous or wrong-tool action; never paste another machine's ending block.

printer-settings:fiberInfillAcceleration.meaning: The acceleration request for continuous-fibre infill routes, distinct from ordinary sparse plastic infill.
printer-settings:fiberInfillAcceleration.when_to_change: Only during supported composite motion qualification with a compatible pair and reliable loading/cutting.
printer-settings:fiberInfillAcceleration.effect: Higher can change tension and placement at route transitions; lower can reduce abruptness while altering dwell and time.
interactions: Matrix feed, bend rules and firmware limits
printer-settings:fiberInfillAcceleration.caution: Do not transfer ordinary plastic infill acceleration or use this to force an ineligible route.
printer-settings:fiberInfillAcceleration.status: Composite role interpretation; physical route behaviour unvalidated.

printer-settings:fiberPreparationAcceler.meaning: The Prime Line acceleration associated with composite fibre preparation.
printer-settings:fiberPreparationAcceler.when_to_change: Only under an OEM-supported preparation calibration after tool/plate alignment and loading are proven.
printer-settings:fiberPreparationAcceler.effect: Changes the motion transient of preparation, potentially affecting priming attachment and feed timing rather than ordinary model speed.
printer-settings:fiberPreparationAcceler.caution: A preparation failure is not a reason to increase motion force. Exact covered commands/roles must be verified.

printer-settings:gCodeAfterExtruderChang.meaning: Executable commands inserted after an extruder/tool change.
printer-settings:gCodeAfterExtruderChang.when_to_change: Only when an OEM-supported workflow or verified hardware change requires a reviewed post-change sequence.
printer-settings:gCodeAfterExtruderChang.effect: May position, heat, prime or change material state after selection; it can override earlier targets or offsets.
interactions: Retraction state, temperatures and firmware macros
printer-settings:gCodeAfterExtruderChang.caution: Do not use it as an undocumented PA injection or copy commands from another tool. Review every change through final output and physical sequence.

printer-settings:gCodeBeforeExtruderChan.meaning: Executable commands inserted before a tool-change operation.
printer-settings:gCodeBeforeExtruderChan.when_to_change: Only for a supported and reviewed alteration of the printer's actual change-tool lifecycle.
printer-settings:gCodeBeforeExtruderChan.effect: Can alter withdrawal, cooling, positioning or preparation before selection; wrong assumptions can leave the next tool state inconsistent.
interactions: Tool-change retraction, offsets and firmware macros
printer-settings:gCodeBeforeExtruderChan.caution: This is not a comment box. Never paste old-unit or generic cutter/feed commands to solve a cosmetic defect.

printer-settings:hasHeatedChamber.meaning: Declares that the printer definition has a supported active chamber heater.
printer-settings:hasHeatedChamber.when_to_change: Only to match verified installed OEM hardware/configuration.
printer-settings:hasHeatedChamber.effect: May expose or generate chamber-heating behaviour; checking the box does not install a heater or validate its sensor.
interactions: Heated chamber index and heat-up rate
printer-settings:hasHeatedChamber.caution: Never enable this to make a desired target available on unsupported hardware or bypass a thermal fault.
printer-settings:hasHeatedChamber.status: Hardware capability declaration; physical validation required.

printer-settings:hasHeatedTable.meaning: Declares that the machine has a controllable heated build plate.
printer-settings:hasHeatedTable.when_to_change: Only to accurately represent the verified installed printer hardware.
printer-settings:hasHeatedTable.effect: Can affect bed-temperature controls/output. The declaration does not prove heating, sensor accuracy or plate compatibility.
interactions: Bed heat-up rate and firmware preparation
printer-settings:hasHeatedTable.caution: Do not toggle a hardware declaration to bypass a failed heater or missing target. Retain the OEM definition unless the hardware change is supported.
printer-settings:hasHeatedTable.status: Hardware capability declaration; actual operation unvalidated.

printer-settings:heatedChamberIndex.meaning: Identifies the heater/channel assigned to chamber control in the printer definition.
printer-settings:heatedChamberIndex.when_to_change: Only when the exact OEM firmware/heater mapping is independently established.
printer-settings:heatedChamberIndex.effect: A different index can direct a request to another channel; it does not just adjust chamber temperature.
interactions: Firmware heater/sensor mapping and material target
printer-settings:heatedChamberIndex.caution: Do not guess the index or infer it from tool numbering. A wrong channel can heat the wrong device or invalidate protection assumptions.
printer-settings:heatedChamberIndex.status: Hardware channel mapping; independent verification required.

printer-settings:inset0Acceleration.meaning: The acceleration request for the ordinary plastic outer wall, the visible boundary of the part.
printer-settings:inset0Acceleration.when_to_change: During a controlled surface/motion comparison after extrusion is stable.
printer-settings:inset0Acceleration.effect: Lower can reduce corner echoes and pressure transients but increase time; higher can reach speed sooner while worsening vibration or sharp-feature quality.
interactions: Effective pressure behaviour and firmware limits
printer-settings:inset0Acceleration.caution: A clean short sample does not qualify the highest value for every part. Do not tune beyond supported mechanical limits.
printer-settings:inset0Acceleration.status: Functional role interpretation; physical limit unqualified.

printer-settings:inset0Jerk.meaning: The outer-wall-specific jerk/cornering request, shown in speed units.
printer-settings:inset0Jerk.when_to_change: Only after the actual firmware interpretation is known, in an isolated wall-transition comparison.
printer-settings:inset0Jerk.effect: Higher may carry more speed through wall corners but amplify disturbance; lower can soften transitions while changing dwell and pressure.
interactions: Regular jerk, jerk enable and firmware cornering
printer-settings:inset0Jerk.caution: Not pressure advance. A familiar jerk value from another firmware is not portable, and exact override precedence must be checked.

printer-settings:insetXFAcceleration.meaning: The acceleration request for continuous-fibre perimeter routes.
printer-settings:insetXFAcceleration.when_to_change: Only when supported composite testing isolates perimeter placement/tension after loading and geometry are credible.
printer-settings:insetXFAcceleration.effect: Sharper acceleration can change strand tension and matrix delivery; gentler motion adds time and changes heat/contact dwell.
interactions: Fibre perimeter speed and bend geometry
printer-settings:insetXFAcceleration.caution: Do not borrow plastic perimeter values or force tight routes by increasing acceleration.
printer-settings:insetXFAcceleration.status: Composite role interpretation; physical performance unvalidated.

printer-settings:insetXPAcceleration.meaning: The acceleration request for ordinary plastic perimeter roles other than the separately identified outer wall.
printer-settings:insetXPAcceleration.when_to_change: When balancing perimeter time and motion quality after flow and outer-wall behaviour are stable.
printer-settings:insetXPAcceleration.effect: Higher can reduce time on short perimeters but add vibration and feed transients; lower makes them gentler but slower.
printer-settings:insetXPAcceleration.caution: Exact wall-role coverage is not established by the label. Check the preview/output instead of assuming all walls receive one value.

printer-settings:kinematicsType.meaning: Declares the machine's motion arrangement so planning can use the appropriate kinematic assumptions.
printer-settings:kinematicsType.when_to_change: Only to match verified physical hardware in a supported printer definition, never as a material or speed tweak.
printer-settings:kinematicsType.effect: Selecting another type changes a machine assumption; it does not physically convert the mechanism or calibrate belts.
printer-settings:kinematicsType.caution: Preserve the OEM choice. The two available labels are not proof that every printer of either type is supported.

options.label: CoreXY
options.meaning: A coupled XY arrangement in which both motors contribute to Cartesian X/Y motion. Do not identify one axis label with one motor without the actual belt mapping.

options.label: Cartesian
options.meaning: The Cartesian machine class, conventionally using independently driven coordinate axes. This is a machine classification, not a fallback for an unknown CoreXY profile.

printer-settings:kinematicsType.status: Schema-backed machine selector; execution effects not independently qualified.

printer-settings:overhangSolidInfillAcce.meaning: The acceleration request for the overhang solid-infill role.
printer-settings:overhangSolidInfillAcce.when_to_change: During a controlled unsupported-edge comparison after geometry, cooling and speed are stable.
printer-settings:overhangSolidInfillAcce.effect: Gentler motion may help attachment and pressure consistency but increases dwell; faster transitions can reduce time while stressing unsupported deposition.
interactions: Support below, line geometry and firmware limits
printer-settings:overhangSolidInfillAcce.caution: It does not create support or change the overhang angle. Verify exact role classification before interpreting a result.
printer-settings:overhangSolidInfillAcce.status: Role interpretation; physical overhang outcome unvalidated.

printer-settings:postprocessorType.meaning: Selects the machine-specific output postprocessor that turns planned paths into the target G-code/workflow dialect.
printer-settings:postprocessorType.when_to_change: Only when creating or maintaining a supported printer definition with a verified firmware contract.
printer-settings:postprocessorType.effect: Can change tool, material-axis, preparation and ending command generation. It is not a cosmetic file-format preference.
printer-settings:postprocessorType.caution: Only SK3 is exposed in this inspected list. Do not substitute a different postprocessor or infer ordinary-slicer compatibility from an output extension.

options.label: SK3
options.meaning: The named postprocessor option in this schema. Its label is not a complete command specification; retain the OEM selection and verify the actual machine/version output.

printer-settings:postprocessorType.status: Schema-backed output selector; full postprocessor contract not reproduced.

printer-settings:regularAcceleration.meaning: The general acceleration request used where a more specific feature setting does not control the move.
printer-settings:regularAcceleration.when_to_change: During supported motion qualification with a stable material baseline and representative geometry.
printer-settings:regularAcceleration.effect: Higher can reduce time on short segments but add vibration/feed transients; lower can make motion gentler at a time cost.
printer-settings:regularAcceleration.caution: Do not assume it overrides every role or raises firmware limits. A highest surviving sample is not automatically the best production setting.
printer-settings:regularAcceleration.status: General motion interpretation; exact precedence unverified.

printer-settings:regularJerk.meaning: The general jerk/cornering-style request used outside more specific role overrides.
printer-settings:regularJerk.when_to_change: Only after verifying the OEM firmware's interpretation and supported motion envelope.
printer-settings:regularJerk.effect: Higher can make transitions more abrupt and faster; lower can slow corners, changing surface appearance, pressure and dwell.
printer-settings:regularJerk.caution: Do not equate it with pressure advance or copy square-corner/junction values from another firmware. Confirm the last effective writer.
printer-settings:regularJerk.status: Firmware-dependent cornering interpretation; exact behaviour unverified.

printer-settings:skirtAcceleration.meaning: The acceleration request for skirt paths printed around, but normally separate from, the model.
printer-settings:skirtAcceleration.when_to_change: When a supported preparation comparison addresses skirt consistency without changing the model's material settings.
printer-settings:skirtAcceleration.effect: Lower can make the first surrounding paths gentler; higher can shorten their time but increase attachment/feed demands.
printer-settings:skirtAcceleration.caution: A skirt is not automatically an attached brim or a valid model-flow coupon. Check what the preview generated.

printer-settings:solidInfillAcceleration.meaning: The acceleration request for ordinary plastic solid-fill paths not handled by more specific surface roles.
printer-settings:solidInfillAcceleration.when_to_change: During controlled time/quality qualification after material throughput and top/bottom support are stable.
printer-settings:solidInfillAcceleration.effect: Higher may speed short fill strokes but increase vibration and boundary pressure; lower may improve transitions while increasing time/heat dwell.
printer-settings:solidInfillAcceleration.caution: Do not use acceleration to hide excessive flow or insufficient support below a top surface. Exact role precedence needs output review.
printer-settings:solidInfillAcceleration.status: Functional role interpretation; exact targeting unverified.

printer-settings:startGCode.meaning: Executable commands used during job startup and preparation.
printer-settings:startGCode.when_to_change: Only for a documented supported printer/firmware workflow change with current hardware and complete output reviewed.
printer-settings:startGCode.effect: Can home, move, heat, select tools, prime and alter coordinate/material state before the model begins.
interactions: Postprocessor, material targets and loading sequence
printer-settings:startGCode.caution: Keep the OEM baseline. Never paste generic PA, extrusion, homing or old-unit commands to tune a material; effects may persist beyond the test.

printer-settings:supportIslandAccelerati.meaning: The acceleration request for ordinary support structures.
printer-settings:supportIslandAccelerati.when_to_change: When qualifying support stability/removal with the same support geometry and material baseline.
printer-settings:supportIslandAccelerati.effect: Lower may reduce disturbance of thin supports; higher may reduce time while increasing oscillation and attachment demands.
interactions: Support interface, cooling and firmware limits
printer-settings:supportIslandAccelerati.caution: This does not select support locations or change interface gap. Do not infer part strength from support surviving.
printer-settings:supportIslandAccelerati.status: Support-role interpretation; physical support result unvalidated.

printer-settings:supportIslandInterfaceA.meaning: The acceleration request for the interface region between supports and the supported part.
printer-settings:supportIslandInterfaceA.when_to_change: During controlled interface quality/removal tests after support generation is correct.
printer-settings:supportIslandInterfaceA.effect: Gentler transitions may improve interface consistency but extend dwell; faster motion can reduce time while disturbing fine contact paths.
printer-settings:supportIslandInterfaceA.caution: It is not the support-interface separation distance or an automatic easy-removal setting.

printer-settings:tableHeatupSpeed.meaning: The declared build-plate heating rate in degrees Celsius per second.
printer-settings:tableHeatupSpeed.when_to_change: Only when a supported hardware/timing calibration measures the real plate's response.
printer-settings:tableHeatupSpeed.effect: May alter heat scheduling or time prediction. A larger number does not increase heater power or guarantee a uniformly soaked plate.
interactions: Material bed targets and start preparation
printer-settings:tableHeatupSpeed.caution: Do not change it to bypass a heater delay/fault. It is not a bed-temperature target or firmware PID calibration.
printer-settings:tableHeatupSpeed.status: Hardware timing interpretation; scheduler details unverified.

printer-settings:topIntermediateSolidInf.meaning: The acceleration request for solid top-region layers below the final exposed top skin.
printer-settings:topIntermediateSolidInf.when_to_change: When qualifying top-support fill motion after shell thickness and extrusion are correct.
printer-settings:topIntermediateSolidInf.effect: Higher can reduce time but increase fill-boundary transients; lower may smooth motion while changing layer time and cooling.
interactions: Final top-skin acceleration and firmware limits
printer-settings:topIntermediateSolidInf.caution: Top Middle is not the final surface itself or a layer count. Verify which paths receive the role.

printer-settings:topMostSolidInfillAccel.meaning: The acceleration request for the outermost visible top solid surface.
printer-settings:topMostSolidInfillAccel.when_to_change: During a top-surface motion comparison with accepted flow, sufficient support and fixed pattern.
printer-settings:topMostSolidInfillAccel.effect: Lower may smooth starts/ends at a time cost; higher may increase throughput but reveal pressure, vibration or boundary defects.
printer-settings:topMostSolidInfillAccel.caution: Acceleration cannot close a top skin that lacks support or correct an incorrect global multiplier by itself.
printer-settings:topMostSolidInfillAccel.status: Functional surface-role interpretation; physical result unvalidated.

printer-settings:travelSpeedXY.meaning: Requested speed for non-printing X/Y travel, in millimetres per second.
printer-settings:travelSpeedXY.when_to_change: After checking supported machine capability and actual travel routing, when balancing ooze time and reliable positioning.
printer-settings:travelSpeedXY.effect: Higher can reduce time spent oozing but increase motion demands; lower is gentler but can leave more time for strings or heat marks.
interactions: Retraction thresholds, wall crossing and clearance
printer-settings:travelSpeedXY.caution: It does not set printed extrusion speed. Do not raise travel speed to hide a collision, lifting part or failed homing.
printer-settings:travelSpeedXY.status: Functional travel interpretation; mechanical limit unqualified.

printer-settings:travelSpeedZ.meaning: Requested vertical travel speed for supported Z moves.
printer-settings:travelSpeedZ.when_to_change: Only during supported machine-motion qualification after checking the actual Z mechanism and firmware limits.
printer-settings:travelSpeedZ.effect: Higher can shorten lifts/layer moves but demand more from the Z system; lower can improve reliability while increasing time and ooze opportunity.
interactions: Z-hop, tool-change lift and combined XYZ moves
printer-settings:travelSpeedZ.caution: XY capability does not imply Z capability. Exact treatment of combined XYZ moves must be checked; do not use this to fix probing or nozzle height.

printer-settings:useAccelerations.when_to_change: Only when the intended division between slicer requests and OEM firmware motion control is understood.
printer-settings:useAccelerations.effect: Enabled can apply general/per-feature acceleration values. Disabled does not make physical acceleration zero; firmware behaviour remains.
interactions: Default axis settings and firmware limits
printer-settings:useAccelerations.caution: Check actual emitted/effective commands. Toggling control ownership can invalidate a comparison even if every visible speed number stays the same.
printer-settings:useAccelerations.status: Control-ownership interpretation; exact command coverage unverified.

printer-settings:useJerks.meaning: Enables the configured jerk/cornering-style requests from Rocket.
printer-settings:useJerks.when_to_change: Only after verifying how the target OEM firmware interprets those requests and which layer should own them.
printer-settings:useJerks.effect: Enabled can apply regular/role jerk values. Disabled does not prove corners stop or the firmware's cornering setting is zero.
printer-settings:useJerks.caution: Do not assume jerk, square-corner velocity and junction deviation share one meaning or portable value.
printer-settings:useJerks.status: Firmware-control interpretation; actual command mapping unverified.

printer-settings:useRelativeExtrusionDis.meaning: Selects whether supported material-feed distances are emitted as increments rather than cumulative positions.
printer-settings:useRelativeExtrusionDis.when_to_change: Only for a verified OEM postprocessor/firmware contract, not routine flow tuning.
printer-settings:useRelativeExtrusionDis.effect: Relative and absolute modes interpret the same numerical feed differently. A mismatch can cause a large unintended feed or withdrawal.
interactions: Start/reset commands, retraction and tool-change hooks
printer-settings:useRelativeExtrusionDis.caution: Preserve the OEM mode and audit every feed/reset path. Do not assume standard E-mode commands safely cover composite V/U/P behaviour.
printer-settings:useRelativeExtrusionDis.status: Critical command-mode declaration; hardware execution unqualified.

printer-settings:version.meaning: A version value associated with the printer definition, not necessarily the firmware or Rocket application version.
printer-settings:version.when_to_change: Only through the supported template-management or documented revision procedure.
printer-settings:version.effect: May influence migration/comparison; increasing it does not upgrade firmware or prove a hardware change is safe.
printer-settings:version.caution: Keep real software/firmware versions separately. Exact template-version rules are unresolved.
printer-settings:version.status: Version metadata interpretation; exact migration rules unresolved.

printer-settings:wipeTowerAcceleration.meaning: The acceleration request for a generated wipe/prime tower used by the selected multi-tool workflow.
printer-settings:wipeTowerAcceleration.when_to_change: Only after confirming the tower actually exists and a controlled preparation comparison addresses its stability.
printer-settings:wipeTowerAcceleration.effect: Lower may improve slender-tower consistency at a time cost; higher may reduce time but disturb priming or attachment.
interactions: Tool changes, material delivery and firmware limits
printer-settings:wipeTowerAcceleration.caution: This is not physical nozzle-cleaning-station acceleration and does not add a tower when none is generated.
printer-settings:wipeTowerAcceleration.status: Feature-role interpretation; visibility and physical result unvalidated.

printer-settings:zLiftOnToolChange.meaning: The vertical lift associated with changing tools, separate from ordinary travel Z-hop.
printer-settings:zLiftOnToolChange.when_to_change: Only through a supported tool-change clearance/alignment procedure on the actual machine.
printer-settings:zLiftOnToolChange.effect: More can increase clearance but add Z motion/time; less reduces the lift and can reduce clearance around fixtures or the part.
interactions: Before/after tool-change code and Z limits
printer-settings:zLiftOnToolChange.caution: Do not guess the amount or copy a previous unit's value. Incorrect clearance can cause a tool/fixture collision.
printer-settings:zLiftOnToolChange.status: Hardware lifecycle motion; exact sequencing unverified.

template:auxiliaryFanPowerPercentage.meaning: An auxiliary-cooling percentage entry in a renderer template, separate from the ordinary tool's main part fan.
template:auxiliaryFanPowerPercentage.when_to_change: Only after confirming that this control is actually exposed for the selected hardware and identifying the physical auxiliary fan.
template:auxiliaryFanPowerPercentage.effect: More side/auxiliary airflow may improve some overhangs but create directional cooling or warp; less reduces those effects.
interactions: Main part cooling, chamber and fan channel mapping
template:auxiliaryFanPowerPercentage.caution: The control type and exact schedule application are unresolved. A source template does not prove this printer has that fan or that the entry is visible.
template:auxiliaryFanPowerPercentage.status: Renderer-template field; runtime exposure and execution unresolved.

template:exhaustFanPowerPercentage.meaning: A percentage entry for an exhaust fan in a renderer template, not the hotend or ordinary part-cooling fan.
template:exhaustFanPowerPercentage.when_to_change: Only when the actual exhaust hardware, ventilation requirements and supported chamber workflow are established.
template:exhaustFanPowerPercentage.effect: More exhaust may remove heat/airborne material but lower chamber stability; less may retain heat while reducing ventilation.
template:exhaustFanPowerPercentage.caution: Do not reduce ventilation contrary to material safety guidance. Control type, exposure, routing and precise scheduling are unresolved.
template:exhaustFanPowerPercentage.status: Renderer-template field; hardware and execution unverified.

template:layerIndex.meaning: A layer identifier associated with the renderer's layer/fan schedule entries.
template:layerIndex.when_to_change: Only after confirming the visible schedule control and how it identifies the intended printed layer.
template:layerIndex.effect: Changing the index can move a scheduled event to another layer. It is not automatically a height in millimetres.
interactions: Actual sliced layer count and variable layer heights
template:layerIndex.caution: Whether counting begins at zero or one, how duplicates are handled, and whether a value persists after that layer are not established. Verify output before relying on it.
template:layerIndex.status: Renderer-template field; index convention and control type unresolved.

unclassified:type.meaning: An unresolved selector whose options refer to Plastic, Composite and Any slot types; its human label and reliable parent menu are missing.
unclassified:type.when_to_change: Do not prescribe a change until the actual dialog, slot purpose and physical tool context are identified.
unclassified:type.effect: It appears to classify or filter a slot definition, but the survey does not establish whether it assigns hardware, filters choices or changes routing.
interactions: Physical tool mapping and compatible selections
unclassified:type.caution: Do not interpret Any as universal hardware compatibility or assume selecting Composite loads fibre. The missing namespace/label is an explicit documentation gap.

options.label: Plastic
options.meaning: The Plastic slot-type choice. Exact assignment/filtering behaviour is unresolved; match any actual use to the verified ordinary plastic path.

options.label: Composite
options.meaning: The Composite slot-type choice. It does not prove physical matrix/fibre loading or a safe composite command sequence.

options.label: Any
options.meaning: The broad slot-type choice in this selector. Its scope is unresolved; it is not permission to interchange ordinary and composite hardware or materials.

unclassified:type.status: Unresolved namespace/label and exact behaviour; choices preserved as evidence.
